change_summary: CBB forward-quality audit: report selected-side close movement and coverage over every explicitly selected input (missing closes stay missing, blocked selected rows stay in the denominator), add selected model/market Brier with equal-event weighting and descriptive market/period/direction strata, and label the proportional research de-vig as not POWER_V1. Frozen v5, model probabilities, risk policy and PAPER/0u unchanged.
assumptions: Selected close coverage counts blocked selected input rows in the denominator; missing closes remain missing and are never backfilled.
Close shift is a same-line probability-point movement, not an executed return.
Direction, market and period strata are descriptive diagnostics only, not causal or refit evidence.
The research de-vig is proportional, not POWER_V1; no Lane A refit eligibility or profitable-refit claim is made.
All output remains PAPER / 0u research; no model release, official counting or wagering is claimed.

baseline.metric: Selected-side close coverage and selected model vs no-vig market Brier on presented CBB cards
